items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: Interviewer mentions 'Charlie Love' as someone who played at Lutchen's; Interviewee does not mention Charlie Love in their response, only discussing Lutchen and Bradley.

ctx.x: It's not like playing a regular dance. You see a regular dance, well you're only, it was for participating in the dancing, but here it was a question of getting refreshments and maybe eating a sandwich or something.

Right now you see Lutchen's I remember Lutchen's I hear them say the old folks home. Now I never played as Lutchen's yet. I never played. But I see Lutchen's, I hear the wonderful, I know the wonderful, Lutchen's, and Bradley, and all the old timers played in the place. And what happened is, you know, we're talking about even more, what do you call them played there, when the people called played there, or Charlie Love.

I played Lutchen's when he was at the lake. He was played there. Well that's been a long time. But I never played at the lake. I'm pretty sure he was at the lake. Wasn't Lutchen's at the lake, years ago? Who? Lutchen. I don't know. I don't know. Well I used to play at home.
